g.text: MEAT
THE BIBLE’S
SYMBOLIC
LANGUAGE
DANIEL LARIMER
Over 140 symbols revealed
DANIEL
LARIMER
Transform how you read Scripture by learning to follow
its symbols, connect its witnesses, and move from
spiritual milk to the meat that strengthens your walk.
“I fed you with milk and not with meat;
for until now you were not able to receive it,
and even now you are still not able.”
1 Corinthians 3:2
“Know ye not this parable?
and how then will ye know all parables?”
Mark 4:13
“For everyone who partakes only of milk
is unskilled in the word of righteousness,
for he is a babe.”
Hebrews 5:13
TIMETESTED.BIBLE
The book ends; the study doesn’t.
An interactive edition of this book
lives at TimeTested.Bible — every
quote and citation linked straight to
the Scriptures, with complete
interlinear tools to help you move
from milk to meat.
Pull every reference by key word, by the
Hebrew or Greek beneath the English,
and by concept — what once took a
lifetime of concordance work now takes
minutes.
Download the ebook free, and have
your friends and family meet the
Bible’s symbolic language.
Test everything; hold to what is good.
TIME TESTED TRADITION
The Renewed Biblical Calendar
by Daniel Larimer
Time Tested Tradition does a deep dive
into history, testing every primary
source and calendar theory against the
sun, moon, and stars to prove the year
of the cross and timing of the appointed
feasts of the LORD. This is must read
meat for those interested in testing
the tradition we have inherited from
our fathers.
Read it free at TimeTested.Bible.
